title: Fail closed when risky-path Git enumeration fails
summary: Distinguish a successfully empty risky-file diff from an unavailable Git query and return nonzero with actionable machine- and human-readable evidence.
reason: Remediate P1 AUDIT-FIND-W11-016. --changed and --staged currently collapse missing Git, timeouts, invalid revisions, permission errors, and nonzero diff commands into an empty path set and report success.
behavior_before: changed_paths returns [] for both a successful empty diff and every Git execution failure; main then emits ok=true and exits zero when the registry schema is valid.
behavior_after: Git enumeration has a bounded timeout and raises a dedicated failure for a missing executable, timeout, nonzero diff command, invalid revision, permission error, or other OS failure. --changed/--staged report enumeration status and path count in JSON, emit actionable stderr, and exit nonzero on failure; a successfully empty query remains an explicit success and trusted --paths does not invoke Git.
tests_added: Successful empty and nonempty Git diffs remain distinguishable and normalized.
Missing Git, timeout, exit 128/invalid revision, and permission failure all raise path-enumeration failure.
--changed --json emits ok=false, structured enumeration evidence, actionable stderr, and exit 1 when enumeration fails.
A successfully empty --changed query emits enumeration_ok=true and exit 0.
Explicit trusted --paths classifies without calling Git.
manual_validation: Risky-file registry and adjacent AI guardrail slice passed: 13 tests and 6 subtests.
Targeted Ruff validation passed for the implementation and tests.
Real --changed --json enumeration passed with 335 paths and 174 risk matches.
Real --staged --json enumeration passed as an authoritative empty set with zero paths and matches.
Targeted summary freshness, project-index/dependency-graph, and feature-map check modes passed.
Canonical risky-file registry validation and git diff --check passed (line-ending warnings only).
Strict worktree coverage passed with 1166 valid change packets.
rollback_plan: Revert the structured enumeration failure, CLI exit/output behavior, focused tests, generated summaries/maps, and this packet together. Document any Git-less caller that needs to migrate to explicit trusted --paths before rollback.
notes: Validation-tooling change only. Explicit --paths behavior remains available for callers that already possess a trusted path set. No media or runtime state is touched.
